property_summary: For any input array _tos with length >= 1, calling transfer(...) on the correct contract always completes (does not revert) and returns true; the mutant that requires _tos.length > 1 will revert for single-element _tos, breaking this property for some inputs.
change_summary: Change the required length check from > 0 to > 1 so calls with a single recipient now revert in the mutant but succeed in original; this alters observable return for inputs with single-element _tos arrays.
